posts.title: Enid Blyton Christmas Gift guide 2026
posts.description: This is my 9th(!) Christmas Gift Guide – you can find the previous eight here . New Books As with every year recently Hodder have released a bunch of new short story collections. Although these are (annoyingly) updated and lack the original illustrations these do seem to be popular with kids and are a good way for anyone to get a hold of stories that haven’t been reprinted in years. Five-Minute Christmas Stories / Stories for the Holidays / Stories for Birthdays / Cosy Bedtime Stories / Stories of Magical Spells / Perfect Pet Stories . All £7.99 at Waterstones. Then there’s the new Malory Towers Mystery Club book by Fleur Hitchcock – Kidnap at Midnight. Kidnap at Midnight , £7.99 at Waterstones And the seasonal Christmas With the Famous Five. This looks like it has the short story Happy Christmas, Five! plus a new story, along with recipes and activities. Christmas With the Famous Five , £12.99 at Waterstones The Magic Faraway Tree Film has gotten a novelisation. The Magic Faraway Tree

posts.title: Good Old Timmy! Colour Short Stories edition
posts.description: I found this at my library and though I should take a look. It was just going to be a brief review, but I’ve already reviewed the actual story when I looked at all the Famous Five Short Stories . My plan then became comparing it to an earlier copy of the story – the one published in the 1997 Red Fox paperback collection. I couldn’t tell just by the quick flick through it whether or not it had been significantly changed, I’m not nearly as familiar with the story as I am the main books. For background the story was originally published in The Princess Gift Book for Girls in 1960, though it’s labelled as the 1961 book as it was an annual. I don’t have this – but I have actually just ordered a copy – so I’ve never seen the original text or the illustrations. Because of that I’m not going to do a word for word comparison like I have for other books (but maybe I will when the annual arrives.) posts.title: Week #707
posts.description: I’m listening to the rain battering down as I write this. I’ve already been soaked once today so I’m hoping it will stop raining before I have to go out again this afternoon. I’m not holding my breath, though. It was raining when I left for work yesterday morning and it rained all day and was still pouring when I came home in the evening. Good Old Timmy – Colour Short Stories edition and Enid Blyton Christmas Gift Guide 2026 From the back of Good Old Timmy: A perfect introduction for new readers and an exciting way to enjoy classic tales for Blyton fans. From me: We’ll see about that…
